==Gifts of Estavus==
In Summer 384YE, the eternal Estavus made certain rituals drawing on her power [[Begin_to_speak#Estavus|available to the Empire]]. The [[mystic scrolls of Estavus]] detail three rituals - [[Mystic scrolls of Estavus#Ramparts of Ashlar|Ramparts of Ashlar]], [[Mystic scrolls of Estavus#Hammers of Fury|Hammers of Fury]], and [[Mystic scrolls of Estavus#Accoutrements of War|Accoutrements of War]]. They are not part of Imperial lore, and cannot be mastered by Imperial citizens, but their capabilities are reasonably common knowledge.
